title: Kindle Paperwhite Signature £139.99, Ninja Crispi £99 and Ring bundle £39.99
description: Tuesday's UK deals: Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at a record low, Ninja Crispi £99, Ring doorbell and camera bundle £39.99, plus De'Longhi and Oral-B.
intro:
**Tuesday's standout is the Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at £139.99 on Amazon, the lowest price it has been.** Amazon's early device deals have also brought a Ring Battery Video Doorbell and Indoor Camera bundle down to £39.99 and the Blink Mini 2K+ to £16.99. In the kitchen, the Ninja Crispi is £99, the Ninja StaySharp knife block is £109.99 and the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next bean-to-cup machine is £379.99.

Every price below was reported on 16 November and all nine picks are at Amazon, so check the price on the product page before you buy. Buy now or wait? The Kindle, Ring bundle and Blink camera are at record or near-record lows, so they're safe buys. Amazon's main Black Friday Week starts on Thursday 19 November, and the coffee machine and Ninja gadgets could still dip a little further.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: The Paperwhite with wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. This is the 2024 model, but it's still Amazon's best all-rounder, and £139.99 is its lowest price yet. Not sure which Kindle to get? See [Kindle vs Kindle Paperwhite](/guides/kindle-vs-kindle-paperwhite/).

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A battery doorbell you can fit without wiring, plus a plug-in indoor camera, for less than the doorbell usually costs on its own. The was price adds both list prices together, but £40 for the pair is still a strong deal. Our [Ring doorbell Black Friday guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/) has more.

deals.name: Blink Mini 2K+ Indoor Security Camera
deals.note: A small plug-in camera for keeping an eye on pets or a front room, with sharper 2K video than the original Mini. Under £17 is a record low.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: Ninja's compact air fryer that cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. A good one for small kitchens or a single person. More Ninja prices in our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi StaySharp Knife Block with Integrated Sharpener
deals.note: A five-knife block with a built-in sharpener, so the blades stay keen without a separate gadget. A useful present for anyone setting up a kitchen.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next Bean-to-Cup Coffee Machine
deals.note: The updated Magnifica Evo, which grinds beans fresh and froths milk at the touch of a button. If you only want espresso and a basic frother, the older Evo was £339.99 at John Lewis yesterday. Compare more in our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: The cheapest way into Oral-B's iO range, with its magnetic drive and pressure sensor. Ignore the £175 'was' price, which it rarely sells at; around £50 is simply a fair price. See our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360 Face Trimmer and Shaver
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one flexible blade, and it's gentle on sensitive skin. A dependable stocking filler for under £40.

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: Twenty-four small Star Wars builds and minifigures for December. It needs to arrive by 1 December, so there's little point waiting. Every other set is in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on Thursday 19 November and runs to Cyber Monday on 30 November. Many of the best Amazon prices need Prime, so if you're not a member, our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time the 30-day trial. Our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) covers what to expect, and our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

If you want an Echo speaker or Fire TV Stick, wait until Thursday: last year the Echo Dot fell to about £30 and the Fire TV Stick 4K to about £25.

## This week: Black Friday kitchen deals

Ninja gadgets and bean-to-cup coffee machines are already close to their lows. Our [Black Friday kitchen deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/) shows what to buy now, what to wait for and the prices worth paying.
